question: Add an interface vocabulary term for a delegation-only browser panel that stores NS hostnames but provides no DNS record editor, with DNS records managed at an external authoritative service (DigitalPlat FreeDomain); the vocabulary also lacks dyndns and git-pull terms.
why: DigitalPlat FreeDomain documents no record API, dyndns update URL, or git pull-request mechanism. The first-party API overview says the API cannot manage external DNS records and that endpoints live only in authenticated documentation; the platform index and product-boundaries pages say no DNS record editor is provided. No existing interface term names this delegation-only pattern, so interface keeps ['unknown'] and interface_detail names the mechanism. A REST API exists but belongs to the separate self-hosted Domain-OSS software, not this hosted service.
